purpose: At a pre-refreshed normal owning return, equal argument/result owners retire before the selected ancestor; cache cleanup throws with no prior injected exception.

<?php

function unusedDetachedSendAliasDrop41($chosen) { echo "TAKE|"; unset($GLOBALS["outer"], $GLOBALS["upper"], $GLOBALS["middle"], $GLOBALS["child"]); echo "CLEARED|"; return $chosen; }
$child = unusedDetachedSendAliasChild41(); $middle = unusedDetachedSendAliasMiddle41(); $upper = unusedDetachedSendAliasUpper41(); $outer = unusedDetachedSendAliasOuter41();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); unset($child); echo "H|";
